neighbours.label: lexical list: the tokens ' disadvantaged' and ' irresponsible'
fire: The charity runs reading clubs for disadvantaged children in the city.
Students from disadvantaged backgrounds receive a small grant.
Funding was moved to the most disadvantaged regions of the country.
Many disadvantaged families cannot afford the bus fare.
Critics called the decision irresponsible and dangerous.
It would be irresponsible to cut the budget for fire safety.
The council accused the company of irresponsible dumping of waste.
Driving that fast in the rain was simply irresponsible.
quiet: The charity runs reading clubs for young children in the city.
Students from poorer backgrounds receive a small grant.
Funding was moved to the most remote regions of the country.
Many low-income families cannot afford the bus fare.
Critics called the decision reckless and dangerous.
It would be unwise to cut the budget for fire safety.
The council accused the company of careless dumping of waste.
Driving that fast in the rain was simply foolish.
